items.detail:
Three things that are a problem at a checkpoint rather than an inconvenience, moved here off the packing list so they are on the page you would actually have open.

NO POLITICAL MATERIAL. A Tibetan flag, images of the Dalai Lama, or literature on Tibetan independence. Permits get pulled over this and it is the one item on the trip with no fallback — your phone's photo roll counts.

NO DRONE. Banned across Tibetan autonomous areas and confiscated at the permit check.

NO US POWER BANKS. China requires a moulded 3C mark that no US-market battery carries, and lithium cannot travel in the hold — an uncertified pack is taken off you at Lhasa on the way to Shanghai. Buy one in Xi'an instead; it is on the packing list.

Also worth leaving at home: jewellery or anything you would mind losing.
items.name: Do not carry into Tibet
